mapper.sql: B.PST_SN, B.PST_TTL, B.PST_CN, B.ETC1 AS LRN_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC1 WHEN 'PRE' THEN '사전학습' WHEN 'MAIN' THEN '본학습' WHEN 'POST' THEN '사후학습' ELSE B.ETC1 END AS LRN_TYPE_NM, B.ETC2 AS DATA_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC2 WHEN 'LINK' THEN '링크' WHEN 'DOC' THEN '문서' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '동영상' ELSE B.ETC2 END AS DATA_TYPE_NM, B.ETC3 AS PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC3 WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE B.ETC3 END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AS PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, B.LNKG_URL_ADDR AS LINK_URL, B.ETC5 AS VIDEO_EMBED_URL, B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, B.WRTR_NM, B.WRTR_ID, B.PSTG_YMD, B.USE_YN, B.INQ_CNT, B.REG_DT, B.RGTR, B.MDFCN_DT, B.MDTR

choose.otherwise: AND ( B.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.PST_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = B.ETC3 AND P.PRGRM_SN = CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND P.DEL_DT IS NULL

SELECT
FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = B.ETC3 AND P.PRGRM_SN = CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND P.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND B.PST_SN = #{pstSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BBS_ARTICLE ( BBS_ID, PST_SN, PST_TTL, PST_CN, WRTR_NM, WRTR_ID, SORT_SEQ, CTGR_CD, NTC_YN, UPEND_FIX_YN, LCK_YN, LNKG_URL_ADDR, PSTG_YMD, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, THMB_FILE_ID, VOD_FILE_ID, USE_YN, INQ_CNT, ETC1, ETC2, ETC3, ETC4, ETC5, ANS_STTS_CD, REG_DT, RGTR, MDFCN_DT, MDTR ) VALUES ( 'LRNSUP', #{pstSn}, #{pstTtl}, #{pstCn}, #{wrtrNm}, #{wrtrId}, 0, NULL, 'N', 'N', 'N', #{linkUrl}, #{pstgYmd}, COALESCE(#{atchFileMngNo}, ''), NULL, NULL, #{useYn}, #{inqCnt}, #{lrnTypeCd}, #{dataTypeCd}, #{prgrmTypeCd}, #{prgrmSn}, #{videoEmbedUrl}, 'WAIT', NOW(), #{rgtr}, NOW(), #{mdtr} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BBS_ARTICLE SET PST_TTL = #{pstTtl}, PST_CN = #{pstCn}, LNKG_URL_ADDR = #{linkUrl}, PSTG_YMD = #{pstgYmd}, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = COALESCE(#{atchFileMngNo}, ''), USE_YN = #{useYn}, ETC1 = #{lrnTypeCd}, ETC2 = #{dataTypeCd}, ETC3 = #{prgrmTypeCd}, ETC4 = #{prgrmSn}, ETC5 = #{videoEmbedUrl}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDTR = #{mdtr} WHERE BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND PST_SN = #{pstSn}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BBS_ARTICLE WHERE BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND PST_SN = #{pstSn}

SELECT P.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' ELSE P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, P.PRGRM_NM, P.USE_YN FROM EDU_PRGRM_MST P WHERE P.DEL_DT IS NULL AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, P.PRGRM_NM
